title: The Whisper
narration: A faint signal, 24.9 billion kilometers away. That's Voyager 1—the farthest human-made object. It's still talking. Still listening.
visual_goal: Deep space star field with a tiny glowing point, then a slow zoom, evoking loneliness and wonder.

title: Leaving Home
narration: Launched in 1977 from Cape Canaveral. It flew past Jupiter, finding volcanoes on Io. Then Saturn, and Titan's thick haze. Then—outward, forever.
visual_goal: Montage of NASA archival footage: launch, Jupiter flyby, Io's volcanoes, Saturn and Titan.

title: Crossing the Boundary
narration: In 2012, it crossed the heliopause—leaving the Sun's bubble. Now it sails interstellar space, at 17 kilometers per second.
visual_goal: Animated diagram of the heliopause crossing, then a starfield rushing past, conveying motion and boundary.

title: The Golden Record
narration: On board: a golden record—greetings, music, Earth's sounds. A message in a bottle, drifting for anyone—or anything—to find.
visual_goal: Close-up of the Golden Record, then rotating, reflecting light, with Earth in the background, evoking fragility and hope.

title: The Last Light
narration: Its power will fade by 2025. But it will keep sailing, silently, for billions of years. Voyager 1—our farthest 'hello'.
visual_goal: Slow fade of the spacecraft's instruments dimming, then a starfield with a tiny dot receding into the dark, leaving a sense of lasting legacy.
